verdicts.title: A countable partition for singular flows, and its application on the entropy theory
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
In this paper, we construct a countable partition $\mathscr{A}$ for flows with hyperbolic singularities by introducing a new cross section at each singularity. Such partition forms a Kakutani tower in a neighborhood of the singularity, and turns out to have finite metric entropy for every invariant probability measure.
